info.title: Audiobookshelf
info.description:
Audiobookshelf REST API — self-hosted audiobook and podcast server.

This specification is reverse-engineered from the Audiobookshelf sources (github.com/advplyr/audiobookshelf, commit 513a067). Upstream's hand-written spec covers roughly 30 of the ~222 routes the server actually registers; the Express routers and their controllers are the authority for every shape here.

## Authentication

Requests carry a JWT access token as `Authorization: Bearer …`. The token is issued by `POST /login` (`user.accessToken` in the response) and refreshed via `POST /auth/refresh`. A handful of routes are reachable without one — server bootstrap (`/init`, `/status`), health checks, the public share endpoints, and the RSS feeds.

bearerAuth.description: Access token issued by `POST /login`. Also accepted as an API key issued through `/api/api-keys`.

episodeId.description: Required if the playlist is a podcast playlist; must be absent for book playlists.

userId.description: Echoed back only when the user query filter was applied

ApiKey.description: API key metadata (ApiKey.toJSON()). The signed JWT string itself is never included here — only at creation time, under ApiKeyWithSecret.

name.description: Baked into the signed JWT at creation; cannot be changed afterward.

expiresAt.description: Null means the key never expires. Set once at creation from expiresIn and never changed afterward.

userId.description: The user this key authenticates as.

createdByUser.description: Only present on GET /api/api-keys (which includes both associations); absent from create/update responses.

ApiKeyPermissions.description: Same shape as UserPermissions; API keys currently default every boolean flag to true (full access) unless the client overrides them at creation. Not exposed for editing via PATCH /api/api-keys/{id} today (only isActive/userId are updatable there), but the field exists on the model.

ApiKeyUserRef.description: Minimal user reference embedded in ApiKey responses.

ApiKeyWithSecret.description: ApiKey plus the raw signed JWT, returned only from the create response.

apiKey.description: The raw signed API key/JWT. Shown exactly once, here, at creation time. Not stored in retrievable form and not returned by any other endpoint.

AudioFile.description: A book's audio file as stored on the LibraryItem/Book media row, including probed audio metadata (Book AudioFileObject).

manuallyVerified.description: Set true once a user has reordered/excluded this file via PATCH /api/items/{id}/tracks.

chapters.description: Chapters embedded in this specific audio file's own metadata (distinct from Book.chapters).

metaTags.description: Raw tag metadata read from the audio file (id3/vorbis/etc.).

AudioTrack.description: A single client-playable audio track, derived from one or more AudioFiles (direct play) or a transcode stream. Present in Book.tracks (expanded item detail) and PlaybackSession.audioTracks.

startOffset.description: Offset, in seconds, of this track within the overall item duration.

AuthSession.description: A login (JWT refresh-token) session, distinct from a playback session.

deviceInfo.description: Best-effort device/browser/OS parsed from the User-Agent header, for display only

current.description: True if this session's refresh token matches the caller's refresh_token cookie / x-refresh-token header

AuthSettings.description: Authentication subset of server settings (ServerSettings.authenticationSettings). Admin-only view; includes the OpenID client secret in cleartext.

authOpenIDClientSecret.description: Returned in cleartext to admins on GET /api/auth-settings; the comment "Do not return to client" in source refers to the public /status payload, not this admin endpoint.

authOpenIDMobileRedirectURIs.description: Allowlist of redirect URIs accepted by the mobile/API OpenID flow, or ['*'] to allow any.

authOpenIDSamplePermissions.description: Pretty-printed JSON string sample of the permissions shape expected from an OpenID advanced-permissions claim.

AuthorExpanded.description: Author.toOldJSONExpanded - Author plus a computed book count. Used only in socket event payloads, not directly returned by these routes.

Backup.description: A saved `.audiobookshelf` backup archive (sqlite database + item/author metadata).

key.description: Backup format key, e.g. `sqlite`. `null` for pre-2.2.24 backups.

path.description: Path relative to the backups directory root, e.g. `backups/<filename>`

serverVersion.description: Audiobookshelf version that created this backup

libraryItems.description: Each item is the fully-expanded shape (toOldJSONExpanded()).

provider.description: Metadata provider slug, e.g. google, audible, itunes. Defaults to google.

overrideCover.description: Replace the item's cover even if one is already set. Defaults to the scannerPreferMatchedMetadata server setting when overrideCover/overrideDetails are both omitted.

overrideDetails.description: Replace matched metadata fields even if already set.

id.description: Must be unique across the batch.

updates.description: Number of items that had at least one field changed.

libraryItemId.description: Only present on toOldJSON()/toOldJSONExpanded(), not on the minified shape.

audioFiles.description: Present on toOldJSON()/toOldJSONExpanded(); replaced by numAudioFiles/numTracks/duration on the minified shape.

chapters.description: Present on toOldJSON()/toOldJSONExpanded(); replaced by numChapters on the minified shape.

tracks.description: Present only on the fully-expanded shape (toOldJSONExpanded); the resolved client-playable track list.

numTracks.description: Present on the minified/expanded shape in place of the full audioFiles/chapters arrays.

duration.description: Present on the minified/expanded shape, in seconds.

ebookFormat.description: Present on the minified/expanded shape in place of the full ebookFile object; null if the book is audio-only.

titleIgnorePrefix.description: Only present on the expanded/minified shape (oldMetadataToJSONMinified/Expanded); the title with a leading article moved to the end for sorting.

authorName.description: Only present on the expanded/minified shape.

authorNameLF.description: Only present on the expanded/minified shape; last name first.

narratorName.description: Only present on the expanded/minified shape.

seriesName.description: Only present on the expanded/minified shape.

descriptionPlain.description: Only present on the fully-expanded shape (oldMetadataToJSONExpanded); description with HTML tags stripped.

BookSearchResult.description: Normalized search result from a book metadata provider. Exact field availability varies by provider; unavailable fields are null.

covers.description: Present for providers (e.g. AudiobookCovers) that return multiple cover candidates per result.

BulkCreatePodcastsFromOpmlRequest.description: Queues an OPML-import background task; podcasts are created asynchronously after this call returns.

feeds.description: RSS feed URLs to import; every entry must be a valid URL.

ChaptersNotFoundResponse.description: In-band error shape returned with HTTP 200 when chapters could not be found or the request was invalid.

ChaptersResponse.description: Raw chapter data proxied from the Audnexus API for the given ASIN/region.

folderPath.description: Absolute path of a known library folder

libraryItemTitle.description: Set when the exact path did not exist but an existing library item was found in a parent of it

CloseSessionRequest.description: Optional final sync data when closing a session. An empty object is treated as absent (session is just closed without syncing).

Collection.description: A user-curated ordered list of books within one library (Collection.toOldJSON).

books.description: Library item ids, in collection order (unexpanded form only).

CollectionExpanded.description: Collection.toOldJSONExpanded - as Collection, but `books` holds expanded library items instead of ids.

books.description: Expanded library items (old JSONExpanded shape; full item/media details are defined by the libraries/library-items route group).

userId.description: User this key will authenticate as. Only root may target the root user.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the key expires. Omit for a key that never expires. Must be > 0 if supplied.

books.description: Library item ids of books to seed the collection with; at least one required.

authHeaderValue.description: Sent as the Authorization header when this provider is queried. Stored and later echoed back verbatim by GET/POST responses.

CreateLibraryFolderRequest.description: At least one of `fullPath` or `path` is required (the handler accepts either name for the same value — `path` is a legacy alias). The value is resolved to an absolute path and the directory is created if missing.

folders.description: Required, non-empty. Every folder is created on disk (`ensureDir`) if it does not already exist; 400 if that fails (e.g. permission denied).

provider.description: Must reference an existing custom provider if it starts with `custom-`.

settings.description: Partial. Only keys belonging to `mediaType`'s default template are honored (see `LibrarySettings` description); everything else is seeded from that template.

slug.description: URL slug identifying the share; must be unique.

expiresAt.description: Unix ms timestamp after which the share stops working. Falsy values (0/null) mean never expires.

CreatePodcastRequest.description: Body for creating a new podcast library item. A folder is created on disk at `path` and, if media.metadata.imageUrl is an http(s) URL, its cover is downloaded into the item folder.

folderId.description: Must be a folder belonging to libraryId.

path.description: Absolute path for the new podcast folder; must be inside the selected library folder.

autoDownloadSchedule.description: Cron expression; validated server-side if present.

password.description: Hashed with bcrypt server-side (cost 8) into `pash`; never echoed back.

permissions.description: Any keys omitted are filled from the default permission set for `type`. Unknown keys and non-boolean values (for boolean fields) are ignored server-side (logged), not rejected.

CreateUserRequest.description: Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

CustomMetadataProvider.description: A custom (self-hosted) metadata provider (CustomMetadataProvider model). GET and POST responses serialize the raw Sequelize instance, which includes authHeaderValue verbatim -- it is not stripped for clients.

mediaType.description: Media type this provider applies to.

authHeaderValue.description: Value sent as the Authorization header when calling this provider. The server echoes this back verbatim in GET /custom-metadata-providers and the create response -- it is not write-only.

DeviceInfo.description: The client/device that recorded a playback session.

DownloadPodcastEpisodesRequest.description: RSS feed episode entries (as returned by the checknew/search-episode/feed endpoints) to queue for download.

EReaderDevice.description: A named send-to-device e-reader target, stored on the server's email settings.

users.description: User ids allowed to use this device; only meaningful (and required) when availabilityOption is specificUsers

EbookFile.description: A book's ebook file. Null if the book has no ebook.

EmailSettings.description:
The server-wide singleton (Database.emailSettings, id is always the literal `email-settings`) holding SMTP configuration and the list of registered e-reader devices. See https://nodemailer.com/smtp/.

Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

port.description: SMTP port. Only port 465 is treated as implicit TLS (`secure`); any other port forces `secure: false` at connection time regardless of the stored `secure` value (see getTransportObject).

secure.description: Whether to use TLS. Coerced to a strict boolean server-side.

rejectUnauthorized.description: Whether to reject self-signed/invalid TLS certs. Coerced to a strict boolean server-side; defaults true if omitted.

testAddress.description: Recipient used by POST /api/emails/test; falls back to fromAddress if unset.

fromAddress.description: The From: address for outgoing mail (test emails and e-book deliveries).

ereaderDevices.description: Registered e-reader devices that can receive e-books by email.

EreaderDeviceObject.description:
An e-reader device that can be sent EPUBs by email. Devices are identified by `name`; there is no separate device id.

Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

name.description: Unique display name identifying the device. Acts as its key: POST /api/emails/ereader-devices replaces the stored array wholesale, matched by this field, and POST /api/emails/send-ebook-to-device targets a device by this name.

email.description: Destination email address for this device.

availabilityOption.description: Who may use this device via POST /api/emails/send-ebook-to-device. Server-normalized on write: missing/invalid values become `adminOrUp`, and `specificUsers` without a non-empty `users` list also falls back to `adminOrUp`.

users.description: User ids allowed to use the device; only meaningful when availabilityOption is `specificUsers`. Server-normalized on write: cleared to an empty array whenever availabilityOption is not `specificUsers`.

Error.description: Error envelope. Many Audiobookshelf handlers instead send a bare `text/plain` message via `res.status(4xx).send(…)`; those responses declare `text/plain` explicitly.

FFProbeResult.description: Raw ffprobe JSON output for the audio file (streams[], format{}, chapters[] as reported by ffprobe -print_format json).

Feed.description: An open RSS feed for a library item, collection, series or playlist (Feed.toOldJSON()). entityType/entityId identify the source entity this feed was opened for.

slug.description: Also used as the feed id suffix and public feed path segment.

entityUpdatedAt.description: Unix ms timestamp of the source entity's last update, used to detect when the feed needs to be refreshed.

FeedEpisode.description: An episode entry within an open RSS feed (FeedEpisode.getOldEpisode()).

FeedMeta.description: Podcast-style channel metadata embedded in a Feed response.

author.description: Only present on the non-minified Feed.toOldJSON() shape.

imageUrl.description: Only present on the non-minified Feed.toOldJSON() shape.

feedUrl.description: Only present on the non-minified Feed.toOldJSON() shape.

link.description: Only present on the non-minified Feed.toOldJSON() shape.

explicit.description: Only present on the non-minified Feed.toOldJSON() shape.

type.description: Only present on the non-minified Feed.toOldJSON() shape.

language.description: Only present on the non-minified Feed.toOldJSON() shape.

FeedMinified.description: Minified Feed shape returned alongside the full feed list, and as the sole response body when a feed is opened/closed (Feed.toOldJSONMinified()).

FileMetadata.description: Filesystem metadata for a single file on disk (FileMetadata.toJSON()).

relPath.description: Path relative to the book's or podcast's folder.

mtimeMs.description: Unix ms timestamp of last modification on disk.

ctimeMs.description: Unix ms timestamp of last status change on disk.

birthtimeMs.description: Unix ms timestamp of creation on disk. 0 if unknown.

dirname.description: Base directory name (or drive letter on Windows root listing)

level.description: Depth relative to the listing root

booksAddedWithCovers.description: Up to 25 library item ids that have a cover on disk

totalBooksSize.description: Bytes, all books added in or before this year

totalBooksDuration.description: Seconds, all books added in or before this year

backupPathEnvSet.description: True if `BACKUP_PATH` env var overrides the configured path

GetAuthorResponse.description: Author plus optional `libraryItems` and `series`, present only when requested via `?include=`.

libraryItems.description: Present only when `include=items`. Minified library items accessible to the user that credit this author.

series.description: Present only when `include=items,series`. This author's books grouped by series.

items.description: Minified library items in the series, sorted by sequence, each annotated with `media.metadata.series`.

opmlText.description: Raw contents of an OPML file.

currentDailyLogs.description: Up to the last 5000 log entries for today. Empty string if no daily log has been initialized yet.

rssFeed.description: URL of the podcast RSS feed to fetch and parse.

isInit.description: True once a root user has been created

authFormData.description: `authOpenIDButtonText`/`authOpenIDAutoLaunch` are present only when `openid` is an active auth method

embedMetadata.description: Raw `data` payload of each queued (not yet started) embed-metadata task

password.description: Hashed with bcrypt into the root user's pash. Omit or send empty for a passwordless root user (logged as a warning server-side).

Library.description:
A library of either books or podcasts (never mixed) — a named collection of one or more filesystem folders that get scanned into library items, plus per-library scan/matching/display settings.

Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

folders.description: Enriched on every read from the library's `libraryFolders` association. NOT the shape used to write folders — see `CreateLibraryRequest.folders` / `UpdateLibraryRequest.folders`, which take bare paths (and, for update, existing folder ids) rather than full folder objects.

displayOrder.description: 1-based position among all libraries. Server-computed on create (always appended as `max+1`; NOT accepted in `CreateLibraryRequest`). Settable via `PATCH` (as a plain field) or in bulk via `POST /api/libraries/order`; either path can produce duplicate/non-sequential values since neither renormalizes the other libraries — only a library *delete* compacts the sequence.

icon.description: Icon key shown in the UI (e.g. `database`, `audiobookshelf`, `podcast`, ...); not validated against a fixed enum server-side. Defaults to `database` on create.

mediaType.description: Selects which `LibrarySettings` default template seeds this library and which content model its items use. Defaults to `book` on create. Technically PATCH-able, but changing it on an existing library does not migrate `settings` or existing items to the new media type's shape — treat as effectively create-only.

provider.description: Preferred metadata provider slug for matching (e.g. `google`, `audible`, `itunes`, or `custom-<slug>` for a configured custom provider, which must already exist). Defaults to `google` on create.

lastScan.description: Epoch ms of the last completed scan. Read-only — set only by the scan job, never accepted on write.

lastScanVersion.description: Server version string at the time of the last scan. Read-only.

lastUpdate.description: Epoch ms of the record's `updatedAt`. Read-only. Note the wire key is `lastUpdate`, not `updatedAt`.

lastFirst.description: "Last, First" formatted name, used for sorting/display.

LibraryAuthorsListResponse.description: Returned when `limit`/`page` are not both present — the unpaginated fallback shape.

LibraryAuthorsPaginatedResponse.description: Returned when both `limit` and `page` query params are present.

LibraryFile.description: A file belonging to a library item's folder on disk (LibraryFile.toJSON()).

ino.description: Inode value, used as the file's id in item file routes.

isSupplementary.description: For ebook files: true if not the primary ebook.

LibraryFilterData.description: Aggregate facet data for a library, cached server-side for 30 minutes.

bookCount.description: Row count from the query used to detect staleness, not a general-purpose total.

numIssues.description: Count of items flagged missing or invalid.

LibraryFolder.description:
A filesystem folder scanned into a library. Always nested under a single library (`onDelete: CASCADE` — deleting the library deletes its folders; deleting a folder via `PATCH .../{id}` deletes every library item sourced from it).

Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

fullPath.description: Absolute POSIX path on the server. Read-only on this representation — see the write-side request schemas for how a folder is added.

LibraryItem.description: A single item on the server, like a book or podcast (LibraryItem.toOldJSON()/toOldJSONMinified()/toOldJSONExpanded()). toOldJSONExpanded is a strict superset of toOldJSONMinified/toOldJSON. Some routes additionally attach userMediaProgress/rssFeed/mediaItemShare/episodeDownloadsQueued/episodesDownloading when requested via ?include=.

relPath.description: Path relative to the library folder.

isFile.description: Whether the item is a single file in the root of its library folder.

lastScan.description: Unix ms timestamp. Only present on toOldJSON()/toOldJSONExpanded().

media.description: Book or Podcast, according to mediaType.

userMediaProgress.description: Only present when GET /api/items/{id}?expanded=1&include=progress is used.

rssFeed.description: Only present when GET /api/items/{id}?expanded=1&include=rssfeed is used.

mediaItemShare.description: Only present for book items when GET /api/items/{id}?expanded=1&include=share is used by an admin.

episodeDownloadsQueued.description: Only present for podcast items when GET /api/items/{id}?expanded=1&include=downloads is used.

episodesDownloading.description: Only present for podcast items when GET /api/items/{id}?expanded=1&include=downloads is used and a download is currently in progress.

LibraryItemInProgress.description: A minified library item (see the Items API for the full shape) annotated with the caller's progress. For a podcast, recentEpisode is the specific episode in progress instead of the parent podcast's own progress.

recentEpisode.description: Present only for a podcast episode in progress

progressLastUpdate.description: Unix ms; the media progress's lastUpdate, used for sorting

LibraryItemMetadataObjectResponse.description: The ffmpeg metadata-file-format representation of the book's tags/chapters, as embeddable via `ffmpeg -i in -i FFMETADATAFILE -map_metadata 1`.

LibraryItemsResponse.description: Pagination/filter envelope; item shape is defined by the items route group.

total.description: `undefined`/absent when `collapseseries` handling is active (see the operation description).

LibraryListResponse.description: Envelope returned by list/reorder — NOT a bare array.

LibraryPersonalizedShelvesResponse.description: Bare array of shelf objects (each e.g. `{id, label, type, entities: [...]}`), NOT wrapped in an envelope.

LibrarySearchResponse.description: Shape differs by `Library.mediaType`. Book libraries populate `book`/`narrators`/`tags`/`genres`/`series`/`authors`; podcast libraries populate a different set built from podcasts/episodes — modeled loosely here since it is not config-relevant.

podcast.description: Podcast libraries. Matches by podcast title.

nameIgnorePrefix.description: `name` with a leading article moved to the end, for sorting.

rssFeed.description: Present only with `?include=rssfeed`, if a feed is open for the series.

results.description: Series objects (see `LibrarySeriesDetail` for the base shape), possibly expanded per `include`.

LibrarySettings.description:
Per-library settings, stored as a single JSON blob (`Library.settings`). The field set is gated by `Library.mediaType`: a **book** library's default template has `skipMatchingMediaWithAsin`, `skipMatchingMediaWithIsbn`, `audiobooksOnly`, `epubsAllowScriptedContent`, `hideSingleBookSeries`, `onlyShowLaterBooksInContinueSeries`, `metadataPrecedence`, plus the shared fields below; a **podcast** library's default template has `podcastSearchRegion` plus the shared fields — it does NOT have the book-only fields. On both create and update, any settings key sent that is not in the *current* mediaType's default-template key set is silently ignored (not rejected, not stored) — this makes `LibrarySettings` effectively two distinct field sets sharing one wire schema, not one flat struct. `coverAspectRatio`/`disableWatcher`/`autoScanCronExpression`/`markAsFinishedPercentComplete`/`markAsFinishedTimeRemaining` are shared by both.

Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

coverAspectRatio.description: 0 = standard (2:3), 1 = square. Shared. On write, type is checked against the current stored value's type (`number`), not restricted to 0/1 by the server, but only these two values are meaningful in the UI.

disableWatcher.description: Shared. Toggling this restarts the filesystem watcher for the library.

autoScanCronExpression.description: Shared. Standard 6-field cron (seconds-first). `null`/absent disables the scheduled scan. On UPDATE, `null` is accepted and disables it; a falsy value (empty string) on CREATE is silently skipped rather than stored as empty. Changing this on update reprograms the scan cron job.

skipMatchingMediaWithAsin.description: Book libraries only. Skip quick-match for books that already have an ASIN.

skipMatchingMediaWithIsbn.description: Book libraries only. Skip quick-match for books that already have an ISBN.

audiobooksOnly.description: Book libraries only. Ignore ebook files entirely except as supplementary files to an audiobook.

epubsAllowScriptedContent.description: Book libraries only. Allow scripted (JS) content inside served epubs. Present in the server's default-settings object but undocumented in the upstream hand-written spec.

hideSingleBookSeries.description: Book libraries only. Hide series that contain only one book from series views.

onlyShowLaterBooksInContinueSeries.description: Book libraries only. "Continue series" shelves skip books at or before the highest sequence number already read.

metadataPrecedence.description: Book libraries only. Ordered precedence of metadata sources used when scanning/matching. Sent value replaces the array wholesale (no merge).

podcastSearchRegion.description: Podcast libraries only. Region code used when searching for podcasts to add.

markAsFinishedPercentComplete.description: Shared. Percent (0-100) of playback progress at which an item is auto-marked finished. When non-null, takes precedence over `markAsFinishedTimeRemaining`. `null` disables percent-based completion.

markAsFinishedTimeRemaining.description: Shared. Seconds of playback remaining at which an item is auto-marked finished. Ignored when `markAsFinishedPercentComplete` is set.

LibraryStats.description: Book libraries include `totalAuthors`/`authorsWithCount`; podcast libraries omit them.

authorsWithCount.description: Book libraries only. Top 10 authors by book count.

numUserPlaylists.description: Count of the current user's playlists in this library.

ListeningStats.description: Aggregate listening totals for the current user, computed live from the full session history.

days.description: Keyed by YYYY-MM-DD, seconds listened that day

dayOfWeek.description: Keyed by day name (e.g. "Monday"), seconds listened

LocalPlaybackSessionPayload.description: A client-recorded (offline) playback session, submitted for merge into the server's session history and the user's media progress.

id.description: Client-generated id; legacy "play_local_*" ids are remapped to a server uuid on first sync

updatedAt.description: Unix ms; drives both the session merge and whether it wins over more-recently-updated server progress

error.description: Present only when success is false

progressSynced.description: Present only when success is true; whether the user's media progress was updated from this session

source.description: File/line the log call originated from

asin.description: If a valid ASIN, looked up directly; otherwise `q` is used for a name search.

q.description: Author name to search for when `asin` is absent/invalid.

MatchLibraryItemRequest.description: All fields optional; unset string fields fall back to values already on the item (or the server default metadata provider).

provider.description: Metadata provider slug, e.g. google, audible, itunes. Defaults to google.

MatchLibraryItemResponse.description: Either { warning } when no match was found, or { updated, libraryItem } when a search was performed.

warning.description: Present only when no match was found for the given provider.

updated.description: Present only when a match was found; true if any field/cover was changed.

libraryItem.description: Present only when a match was found; the item's fully-expanded shape (toOldJSONExpanded()).

MediaItemShare.description: Client-safe view of a mediaItemShare row (excludes internal fields such as `pash` and `userId`).

MediaItemSharePublic.description: Full mediaItemShare row (as returned by the model's default serialization) plus an attached playback session, returned to the public share viewer.

pash.description: Internal share access hash column; echoed to public clients as part of the model's raw serialization.

userId.description: ID of the admin who created the share.

MediaProgress.description: A user's progress on a single media item (audiobook or ebook progress on a book, or a podcast episode).

mediaItemId.description: Id of the underlying book or podcastEpisode row

MediaProgressUpdatePayload.description: Client-supplied fields for creating/updating a media progress record. All fields are optional; libraryItemId/episodeId come from the path (or, for batch update, must be included per-item in the body).

libraryItemId.description: Required for batch update; taken from the path for the single-item endpoint

lastUpdate.description: Unix ms; used for local-sync merging

markAsFinishedTimeRemaining.description: Seconds; overrides the library's default finished-detection threshold

markAsFinishedPercentComplete.description: 0-100; overrides the library's default finished-detection threshold

Notification.description:
One configured notification rule, stored inside NotificationSettings.notifications. Shape of server/objects/Notification.js's toJSON().

Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

id.description: Server-generated (uuidv4) on creation via POST /api/notifications. Distinct from the NotificationSettings singleton id.

libraryId.description: Restricts the notification to events from this library; null/omitted applies to all libraries.

urls.description: Apprise notification URLs (see https://github.com/caronc/apprise) the payload is POSTed to via the configured Apprise API.

titleTemplate.description: Title template; `{{variable}}` placeholders are filled from the firing event's data.

bodyTemplate.description: Body template; `{{variable}}` placeholders are filled from the firing event's data.

enabled.description: Whether this rule fires. Toggling from disabled to enabled resets `lastFiredAt`, `lastAttemptFailed`, and `numConsecutiveFailedAttempts`.

type.description: Free-form styling hint for the client UI; the server does not validate it against this enum. On creation, if omitted the stored value is `null`, not `info` despite the in-memory default before a payload is applied.

lastFiredAt.description: Unix ms timestamp of the last delivery attempt, or null if never fired (or just re-enabled).

lastAttemptFailed.description: Whether the last delivery attempt failed.

numConsecutiveFailedAttempts.description: Consecutive failure count; once it reaches NotificationSettings.maxFailedAttempts the rule is auto-disabled (`enabled` set false).

numTimesFired.description: Total number of delivery attempts, success or failure.

createdAt.description: Unix ms timestamp set when the notification was created.

NotificationEvent.description: One entry of the static, in-memory event catalog defined in server/utils/notifications.js (module.exports.notificationData.events). Not persisted; identical for every server instance running the same version.

name.description: The event's identifier, used as `eventName` when creating/updating a Notification.

requiresLibrary.description: Whether a notification for this event may be scoped to a single library via `libraryId`.

libraryMediaType.description: The library media type this event applies to (e.g. `podcast`). Only present on events where `requiresLibrary` is true; absent (undefined, not merely null) on the rest.

description.description: Human-readable summary of when the event fires, shown in the UI.

variables.description: Template variable names available to this event's `titleTemplate`/`bodyTemplate` via `{{variable}}` interpolation.

defaults.description: Suggested default templates the client UI pre-fills when creating a notification for this event.

testData.description: Sample values for each of `variables`, used to render the templates when GET /api/notifications/{id}/test fires this event. Most values are strings, but some (e.g. `numFailed` on the RSS events) are numbers, so no single scalar type is enforced.

NotificationEventName.description: The event this notification listens for.

NotificationSettings.description:
The server-wide singleton (Database.notificationSettings, id is always the literal `notification-settings`) holding Apprise configuration and every configured notification rule.

Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

id.description: Always `notification-settings`; this is the settings singleton's id, unrelated to individual Notification ids (which are uuids).

appriseType.description: Apprise backend type. Currently always `api` (only the Apprise API-server integration is implemented).

appriseApiUrl.description: Base URL of the Apprise API server notifications are POSTed to. Notifications are inert (`isUseable` is false) while this is unset.

maxFailedAttempts.description: Consecutive failures after which a rule is auto-disabled. Omitting it (or sending a non-numeric value) resets it to 5, rather than leaving the stored value alone.

maxNotificationQueue.description: Max events queued while a prior notification send is in flight; once full, further events are dropped. Omitting it (or sending a non-numeric value) resets it to 20, rather than leaving the stored value alone.

shareSessions.description: Open playback sessions belonging to active public share links

OpmlFeedEntry.description: A single <outline type="rss"> entry extracted from an OPML file.

mediaMetadata.description: Snapshot of BookMetadata or PodcastMetadata at session start.

timeListening.description: Accumulated listening time for this session, in seconds.

startTime.description: Media currentTime at the start of this session, in seconds.

libraryItem.description: The library item's fully-expanded shape (toOldJSONExpanded()), or null.

PlaybackSessionClient.description: A PlaybackSession as sent to clients while open: adds the audio track list, the full embedded library item, and (share sessions only) a cover aspect ratio.

libraryItem.description: Full library item (see the Items API); null if not found

coverAspectRatio.description: Only set for share-link playback sessions

Playlist.description: An ordered, user-owned list of book or podcast-episode media items within one library (Playlist.toOldJSON).

libraryItem.description: Expanded library item (see libraries/library-items route group).

PlaylistEpisodeItem.description: A podcast-episode entry within a playlist's expanded item list.

PlaylistExpanded.description: Playlist.toOldJSONExpanded - as Playlist, plus ordered `items`, each either a book item or a podcast-episode item.

audioFile.description: The AudioFile object for this episode's media file.

audioTrack.description: Present only on the expanded shape (toOldJSONExpanded); the playable AudioTrack derived from audioFile.

size.description: Present only on the expanded shape.

duration.description: Present only on the expanded shape, in seconds.

PodcastEpisodeEnclosure.description: The episode's audio enclosure as stored on the model (derived from enclosureURL/enclosureType/enclosureSize).

length.description: Byte size of the enclosure, stringified.

PodcastLibraryItem.description: A LibraryItem whose media is a Podcast (LibraryItem.toOldJSON()/toOldJSONMinified()/toOldJSONExpanded(), with media resolved to the Podcast shape). toOldJSONExpanded is a strict superset of toOldJSONMinified/toOldJSON.

PodcastMetadata.description: Metadata for a podcast, taken from PodcastMetadata.oldMetadataToJSON()/oldMetadataToJSONExpanded().

type.description: Podcast type, e.g. episodic or serial.

titleIgnorePrefix.description: Only present on the expanded/minified shape (oldMetadataToJSONExpanded); the title with a leading article moved to the end for sorting.

nameIgnorePrefix.description: Display name with any leading article moved to the end (e.g. "Foundation, The").

SeriesGetResponse.description: Series plus optional `progress` and `rssFeed`, present only when requested via `?include=`.

rssFeed.description: Present only when `include=rssfeed`; null if the series has no feed.

ServerSettings.description: Browser-safe view of the `ServerSettings` singleton (`toJSONForBrowser()`): secrets (`tokenSecret`, `authOpenIDClientID`, `authOpenIDClientSecret`, `authOpenIDMobileRedirectURIs`, `authOpenIDGroupClaim`, `authOpenIDAdvancedPermsClaim`) are stripped before this is sent to the client.

metadataFileFormat.description: As of v2.4.5 only `json` is supported; any other stored value is coerced back to `json`.

allowIframe.description: Forced true if the `ALLOW_IFRAME=1` environment variable is set; cannot be disabled via the API while that env var is set.

backupPath.description: Defaults to `<MetadataPath>/backups`. Overridden by the `BACKUP_PATH` env var if set.

backupSchedule.description: Cron expression for automatic backups, or `false` to disable them.

maxBackupSize.description: Maximum backup size in GB; a new backup that would exceed this is refused.

podcastEpisodeSchedule.description: Cron expression for podcast episode checks

authLoginCustomMessage.description: HTML-sanitized custom message shown on the login screen

timeZone.description: Host IANA timezone, computed at response time (not persisted)

SharePlaybackSession.description: Playback session for a share viewer, built from the shared item's audio tracks.

StartPlaybackSessionRequest.description: Playback session request options (PlaybackSessionManager.startSessionRequest). Also accepts arbitrary extra client fields, which are ignored server-side.

deviceInfo.description: Client device identification, merged onto the request's User-Agent-derived DeviceInfo.

forceDirectPlay.description: Force direct play even if the client's supportedMimeTypes wouldn't normally allow it.

forceTranscode.description: Force a transcoded HLS stream instead of direct play.

mediaPlayer.description: Client player identifier, echoed back on the session. Defaults to "unknown".

supportedMimeTypes.description: Mime types the client can play directly; used to decide direct play vs transcode.

SyncSessionRequest.description: Progress delta reported by a client for an open session.

timeListened.description: Seconds of playback time to add to the session's running total

duration.description: Optional; overrides the session's known media duration if provided

Task.description: A background task tracked by `TaskManager` (encode-m4b, embed-metadata, scan, etc).

UpdateApiKeyRequest.description: Only these two fields are updatable; name/expiresIn are immutable once the key is signed.

userId.description: Reassign the key to a different user. Only root may reassign to/from the root user.

UpdateAuthSettingsRequest.description: Partial update; any key from AuthSettings may be supplied (except the read-only authOpenIDSamplePermissions, which is ignored). Unrecognized keys are ignored.

authActiveAuthMethods.description: Must be non-empty and drawn only from supported methods, or the update to this key is dropped (with a warning) while other keys still apply.

authOpenIDMobileRedirectURIs.description: Each entry must match scheme://host[/path] or the array must be exactly ['*'].

UpdateAuthorRequest.description: Only `name`, `description`, `asin` are honored; each may be a string or explicit null (except name, which must be a non-empty result after other validation).

updated.description: True if a field changed. Absent when a merge occurred.

merged.description: True if this update caused a merge into an existing same-named author; `author` is then the surviving (other) author.

path.description: New backup directory path (absolute or relative; resolved against the server's cwd)

books.description: Library item ids in the desired order; reorders existing collection books to match. Ignored if empty/absent.

UpdateLibraryFolderRequest.description: Presence of `id` is the discriminator: with `id`, the entry identifies an existing folder to keep (its `fullPath`/`path` here is ignored — only used to match); without `id`, `fullPath`/`path` is required and a new folder is created.

id.description: Omit to create a new folder; include to keep an existing one (see `UpdateLibraryRequest.folders`).

cover.description: Absolute path, on the server, of an existing image file to use as the cover.

UpdateLibraryItemMediaRequest.description: Partial update applied via LibraryItemMedia.updateFromRequest(). Any field omitted is left unchanged. `metadata.series`/`metadata.authors` accept plain name strings and will create new Series/Author rows as needed.

metadata.description: Partial BookMetadata (for book items) or PodcastMetadata (for podcast items) fields to update.

url.description: If present, downloads and sets this as the item's cover before applying the rest of the payload (equivalent to POST .../cover with { url }).

autoDownloadSchedule.description: Podcast items only. Cron expression; validated and rejected with 400 if malformed.

UpdateLibraryItemTracksRequest.description: Reorders and/or excludes a book's audio files. Every entry's ino must already exist in the book's audioFiles.

ino.description: Must match an existing AudioFile.ino on the book.

exclude.description: If true, the file is excluded from playback (index set to -1).

UpdateLibraryRequest.description: All fields optional; only present, truthy top-level fields are applied (see `Library` for why `displayOrder` and mediaType behave the way they do).

provider.description: Must reference an existing custom provider if it starts with `custom-`.

settings.description: Partial, merged key-by-key over the library's current settings. Only keys belonging to the library's *current* mediaType's template are honored — an unrecognized key is silently dropped, not rejected.

folders.description: NOT a merge-by-name/path — this is a **replace-by-id** operation and is destructive. Semantics: (1) any entry WITHOUT an `id` is treated as a brand-new folder — its `fullPath`/`path` is resolved and the directory created if needed. (2) any folder the library CURRENTLY has whose `id` does NOT appear in this array is DELETED, which cascades: every library item sourced from that folder is permanently removed (including now-orphaned authors/series). **Consequence for a declarative sync tool: to keep an existing folder, its full object with `id` must be echoed back in every update; omitting an existing folder's `id` deletes it and everything scanned from it, even if a folder with the same `fullPath` is simultaneously being "added".**

updated.description: Number of book library items whose narrator list was changed.

items.description: Must be the same length as the playlist's current items; reorders them to match this order.

UpdatePodcastEpisodeRequest.description: Partial update; every property is optional and only recognized keys of the correct type are applied. Unrecognized keys are silently ignored.

chapters.description: Replaces all chapters; every entry must have a title and a start.

UpdateSeriesRequest.description: At least one of `name`/`description` (both plain strings) must be present.

UpdateServerSettingsRequest.description:
Partial `ServerSettings` update. Any key omitted is left unchanged; `sortingPrefixes` is accepted but silently ignored (use `PATCH /api/sorting-prefixes`). Includes fields never echoed back by `GET`-style responses (OpenID client secret, mobile redirect URIs, group/permission claims).

Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

allowIframe.description: Cannot be set to `false` while the `ALLOW_IFRAME=1` environment variable is set (400).

backupPath.description: Prefer `PATCH /api/backups/path`, which also validates and reloads the backup manager.

backupSchedule.description: Cron expression, or `false` to disable auto-backups. Changing this immediately reloads the backup cron schedule.

allowedOrigins.description: Rejected with 400 if not an array.

authOpenIDClientSecret.description: Never echoed back by any settings response.

authOpenIDMobileRedirectURIs.description: Never echoed back; app-scheme redirect URIs for the mobile OpenID flow.

sortingPrefixes.description: Deduplicated, trimmed, lower-cased before saving. Must be non-empty after normalization.

rowsUpdated.description: Total books + podcasts + series whose ignore-prefix column changed

UpdateUserRequest.description: All fields optional; only supplied fields that actually differ from current values are applied. `id`, `pash`, `token`, `extraData`, and `bookmarks` are rejected with 400 if present.

username.description: Changing this regenerates the legacy API token and invalidates JWT sessions.

password.description: New plaintext password; hashed server-side. Invalidates JWT sessions for this user. For an admin changing their own password, prefer the /me password endpoint instead, since this one does not return refreshed tokens for the current session.

type.description: Silently dropped if the target is the root user, even when supplied.

lastSeen.description: Epoch millis. Rarely set by clients; primarily server-maintained.

permissions.description: Merged onto the user's existing permissions; only recognized keys with boolean values are applied.

UpdateWatchedPathRequest.description: Manually notifies the folder watcher of a filesystem change, as if it had been observed natively.

path.description: Absolute path of the added/removed/renamed file

file.description: The `.audiobookshelf` backup archive (a zip file containing `absdatabase.sqlite` and a `details` entry).

url.description: http(s) URL to download the cover image from.

UploadLibraryItemRequest.description: Multipart upload of one or more files that will become (or be added to) a library item. Files are moved into `<folder>/[author/][series/]title/`, sanitizing each path segment.

title.description: Required. Used as the output directory name (and, for non-podcast libraries, combined with author/series).

author.description: Optional. Book libraries only; included in the output directory path.

series.description: Optional. Book libraries only; included in the output directory path.

folder.description: Required. id of one of the target library's folders (LibraryFolder.id).

library.description: Required. id of the target library.

files.description: One or more files to upload (multipart field name(s) become the map keys server-side; any field(s) that are files are accepted).

type.description: "root" cannot be assigned via the API (there can only be one, created via /init); create/update only accept admin/user/guest.

token.description: Legacy, non-expiring API token for this user. Regenerated whenever username changes. Returned as an empty string instead of the real token when the requester is not root and the target user is root.

isOldToken.description: Set transiently by JWT auth middleware when the presented token no longer matches the user's stored legacy token; not persisted.

librariesAccessible.description: Duplicate, top-level mirror of permissions.librariesAccessible for legacy clients.

itemTagsSelected.description: Duplicate, top-level mirror of permissions.itemTagsSelected for legacy clients.

seriesHideFromContinueListening.description: Series ids hidden from this user's Continue Listening shelf; managed via dedicated endpoints, not writable here.

mediaProgress.description: Omitted on the list endpoint. Managed via dedicated media-progress endpoints, not writable here.

hasOpenIDLink.description: True if extraData.authOpenIDSub is set. Cleared via PATCH /api/users/{id}/openid-unlink.

totalTime.description: Sum of timeListening across all sessions, in seconds.

items.description: Map of libraryItemId -> per-item listening summary.

UserLoginResponse.description: Login/session context payload, returned by /login, /auth/refresh, and (without fresh tokens) /api/authorize.

download.description: Defaults true for all account types.

delete.description: Defaults true for root only.

selectedTagsNotAccessible.description: Inverts the meaning of itemTagsSelected: when true, itemTagsSelected is a denylist instead of an allowlist. Defaults false.

get.summary: List all API keys
get.description: Admin/root only (`ApiKeyController.middleware`). Returns every API key with its owning user and creating user (id/username/type only). Never includes the raw JWT string — only the DB record.

403.description: Requesting user is not admin/root

post.summary: Create a new API key
post.description: Admin/root only. Creates a long-lived (or expiring, via `expiresIn` seconds) JWT bound to `userId`, storing only its metadata in the DB. Only root may create an API key for the root user (403 otherwise). The raw key string is returned exactly once, in this response, under `apiKey.apiKey` — it is never retrievable again afterward.

200.description: API key created; `apiKey.apiKey` holds the raw token, shown only this once

400.description: Missing/invalid name, expiresIn, or userId, or userId does not resolve to a user

403.description: Non-root user attempted to create a root user's API key

patch.description: Admin/root only. Only `userId` (reassign owner) and `isActive` may be changed here — `name` and `expiresIn` are baked into the signed JWT and cannot be altered after creation. Only root may update a root user's API key, and only root may reassign a key to the root user.

200.description: API key updated (or unchanged if the payload matched current values)

400.description: Invalid userId/isActive, or userId does not resolve to a user

403.description: Non-root user attempted to update/reassign a root user's API key

404.description: API key not found

delete.description: Admin/root only. Permanently revokes the key (subsequent requests bearing its JWT will fail JWT auth lookup by keyId).

403.description: Requesting user is not admin/root

404.description: API key not found

get.summary: Get server authentication settings
get.description: Admin/root only. Returns the authentication-related subset of server settings, including the OpenID client secret in cleartext (it is only ever hidden from the client-facing `/status` and `authFormData` payloads, not from this admin endpoint) and a sample permissions JSON string for configuring OpenID group/claim mapping.

403.description: Requesting user is not admin/root

patch.description: Admin/root only. Body is merged key-by-key against the current authentication settings (only recognized keys with a defined value in the body are considered; unrecognized keys are ignored). `authActiveAuthMethods` must be a non-empty array drawn from the supported methods (`local`, `openid`); `authOpenIDMobileRedirectURIs` must be an array of scheme://host[...] URIs or exactly `['*']`. On persisted change, live-(de)activates the corresponding passport strategies and persists via `Database.updateServerSettings()`.

serverSettings.description: Full ServerSettings.toJSONForBrowser() object; see the settings route group for its shape.

400.description: Body is not an object

403.description: Requesting user is not admin/root

post.summary: Re-validate the current bearer token / API key and return a fresh login payload
post.description: Requires a valid bearer token (any authenticated user). Used by clients to confirm a stored token/API key is still valid and to refresh their local copy of user/server/ereader-device data without performing a full login. Does not rotate or return new tokens.

get.summary: Get an author
get.description: Returns the author. Supports `?include=items` (adds `libraryItems`: the author's accessible library items, minified) and `?include=items,series` (also groups those items by series into a `series` array of `{id, name, items}`, sorted by sequence). AuthorController.middleware does not check library access, so any authenticated user can fetch any author by id regardless of library restrictions.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of extra entities to include. Recognized values: `items`, `series` (series grouping requires `items` to also be present).

404.description: Author not found

patch.description: Updates `name`, `description`, and/or `asin` (string or null). If `name` is changed and it collides (case-sensitive, same library) with another existing author, the two authors are merged: this author's books are reassigned to the matching author, this author is destroyed (emits `author_removed`), and the surviving author is returned with `merged: true` instead of being updated in place. Otherwise updates in place; on a name change, propagates the new name to every book's cached metadata and rewrites each library item's metadata file. Emits `author_updated`.

200.description: Author updated, or merged into an existing author of the same name

400.description: No valid keys (name/description/asin) found in the request body

403.description: User lacks update permission

404.description: Author not found

delete.description: Removes the author from every book that references them (rewriting each library item's metadata file), purges the author's cached image if any, deletes the author, updates in-memory filter data, and emits `author_removed`.

403.description: User lacks delete permission

404.description: Author not found

get.summary: Get an author's image
get.description: Streams the author's cover image, resized and encoded per query params (result is disk-cached). With `raw=1` (or any truthy value), streams the original image file as-is via `res.sendFile` instead of the resized/cached version. Note: unlike the other author routes this one bypasses AuthorController.middleware entirely, so it performs no library-access check beyond global /api authentication.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Output width in pixels, clamped to 1-4096. Ignored when `raw` is set.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Output height in pixels, clamped to 1-4096. Ignored when `raw` is set.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output image format. Defaults to webp if the client's Accept header supports it, otherwise jpeg. Ignored when `raw` is set.

parameters.name: raw

get.summary: Get a user's playback sessions, paginated
get.description:
Requires admin/root, or the user themself. Returns the user's playback sessions (newest `updatedAt` first), paginated, each annotated with a minimal `user: { id, username }` object to match the shape of the global sessions endpoint.

Note: the response's per-session user object comes from `req.reqUser` (set by `UserController.middleware`) while the session lookup itself uses `req.params.id`; the two are equivalent because the middleware already 404s when the id does not resolve to a user.

parameters.name: itemsPerPage
parameters.description: Page size. Falls back to 10 if not a valid number.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page index. Falls back to 0 if not a valid number.

sessions.description: PlaybackSession objects (see the sessions route group) plus a minimal `user` object.

403.description: Requesting user is neither admin/root nor the target user

404.description: User not found

get.summary: Get a user's aggregate listening statistics
get.description: Requires admin/root, or the user themself. Aggregates the user's playback sessions into total listening time, per-item totals, per-day totals, per-day-of-week totals, today's total, and the 10 most recent sessions.

403.description: Requesting user is neither admin/root nor the target user

404.description: User not found

patch.summary: Unlink a user from their OpenID subject
patch.description: Requires admin/root (PATCH is admin-gated). Clears `extraData.authOpenIDSub` for the target user so they no longer auto-match an OpenID identity. No-op (still 200) if the user has no linked OpenID sub. Emits socket event `user_updated`.

403.description: Requesting user is not admin/root

404.description: User not found

post.summary: Validate a cron expression
post.description: Checks whether `expression` parses as a valid cron pattern using the bundled `node-cron` parser. Used by the settings UI to validate schedule fields (`backupSchedule`, `podcastEpisodeSchedule`) before saving. Not gated by `isAdminOrUp` in code, only by the general auth middleware.

200.description: Expression is a valid cron pattern

400.description: `expression` missing, or not a valid cron pattern

post.summary: Notify the server of a manual filesystem change
post.description: Forwards a file add/remove/rename event to the folder `Watcher`, as if its own fs watcher had observed it. Intended for platforms/mounts where native file-watching is unreliable and the client (or an external script) needs to push change notifications manually.

400.description: Missing `libraryId`/`path`/`type`, `oldPath` missing for a `rename`, or `type` is not one of `add`/`unlink`/`rename`

403.description: Not an admin

get.summary: Start an OpenID Connect login (web or mobile/API flow)
get.description: No bearer token required. Redirects (302) the browser to the configured identity provider's authorization endpoint. Web flow (no `redirect_uri`/`code_challenge`/`response_type=code`) requires `callback` (or `redirect_uri`) query param, same-origin-validated, saved to a short-lived cookie. Mobile/API flow is triggered by presence of `response_type=code`, `redirect_uri`, or `code_challenge`; it requires `redirect_uri` to be whitelisted in `authOpenIDMobileRedirectURIs` and `code_challenge` (PKCE, S256 only) to be present. Rate-limited like `/login`.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Web flow: same-origin URL to redirect back to after login with the token appended. Required for the web flow unless `redirect_uri` is given instead.

parameters.name: redirect_uri
parameters.description: Mobile/API flow: must be present in the server's `authOpenIDMobileRedirectURIs` allowlist (or that list is `['*']`). Presence of this param triggers the mobile/API flow.

parameters.name: code_challenge
parameters.description: PKCE code challenge, required for the mobile/API flow.

parameters.name: code_challenge_method
parameters.description: PKCE method; only `S256` is supported if provided.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Only used/allowed on the mobile/API flow; rejected with 400 on the web flow.

302.description: Redirect to the identity provider's authorization URL

400.description: Missing/invalid callback URL, invalid response_type, invalid/missing redirect_uri, missing/invalid code_challenge, or state supplied on the web flow

429.description: Too many authentication attempts from this client

500.description: Unexpected error building the authorization URL

get.summary: Fetch an OpenID issuer's discovery document
get.description: Requires a valid bearer token AND admin/up (checked explicitly in the handler, in addition to the base JWT check applied via `this.isAuthenticated` middleware on this route). Helper used by the admin authentication-settings UI to auto-populate OpenID endpoint URLs: fetches `<issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration` server-side and returns the relevant fields. Not proxied through `/api`, so it is not gated by the `authNotNeeded`/`ifAuthNeeded` logic that guards `/api/*` — auth is applied directly on this route.

400.description: Missing/invalid issuer query param, invalid issuer URL, or the discovery document could not be fetched

missing.value: Invalid request. Query param 'issuer' is required

403.description: Requesting user is not admin/up

get.summary: OAuth2 callback landing point for mobile clients, forwards to the app's own redirect URI
get.description: No bearer token required. This is the `redirect_uri` mobile clients are sent to after `/auth/openid` for the mobile/API flow; it looks up the previously-whitelisted `mobile_redirect_uri` by the `state` value (stored server-side during `/auth/openid`) and 302-redirects the client there with `code`/`state` appended, so the mobile app (registered for a custom URL scheme like `audiobookshelf://oauth`) can complete the exchange itself. Rate-limited like `/login`.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The state value issued by `/auth/openid` for this flow.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The authorization code from the identity provider, forwarded through to the mobile redirect URI.

302.description: Redirect to the whitelisted mobile redirect URI with `code` and `state` appended

400.description: Unknown/expired state, or no redirect URI associated with it

429.description: Too many authentication attempts from this client

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new access token
post.description: No bearer access token required; authenticates via the refresh token itself, taken from the `refresh_token` cookie or, if present, the `x-refresh-token` header (header takes precedence and, when used, causes the (possibly rotated) refresh token to also be returned in the JSON body rather than only set as a cookie). Rate-limited like `/login`.

parameters.name: x-refresh-token
parameters.description: Refresh token, as an alternative to the `refresh_token` cookie. When supplied this way, the response also returns the refresh token in the body and the response is treated as API/mobile-based.

Set-Cookie.description: Sets the rotated `refresh_token` cookie when the refresh token was supplied via cookie rather than the `x-refresh-token` header.

401.description: No refresh token provided, or it is invalid/expired/revoked

429.description: Too many authentication attempts from this client

get.summary: Get a podcast/collection/series RSS feed
get.description: Looks up the open `feed` row by slug; if it's stale (source entity changed since last build), rebuilds it from the underlying library item/collection/series/playlist first, then renders and returns the RSS 2.0 XML. Mounted outside `/api`, so it needs no bearer token — the unguessable `slug` (set when the feed was opened via the authenticated feed-management endpoints) is the access control.

404.description: No open feed with that slug.

get.summary: Get a feed's cover image
get.description: Streams the feed's cover image file from disk. Registered as an Express wildcard (`/feed/:slug/cover*`) so any suffix after `cover` is accepted and ignored — clients typically append a fake extension (e.g. `cover.jpg`) for player compatibility. No auth token required; gated only by knowledge of the feed slug.

200.description: Cover image, streamed with `Content-Type: image/<ext>` inferred from the stored file's extension.

404.description: No such feed, or the feed has no cover.

get.summary: Download a feed episode's audio file
get.description: Resolves `episodeId` to its underlying `feedEpisode` file path and streams it. Registered as an Express wildcard (`/feed/:slug/item/:episodeId/*`) — the trailing path segment (typically a fake filename for player compatibility) is accepted and ignored. No auth token required; gated only by knowledge of the feed slug and episode ID, which is how podcast clients fetch RSS enclosures.

200.description: Episode audio file. `Content-Type` is corrected from the file extension for formats (e.g. `.m4b`) Express mistypes.

404.description: No such feed, or no episode with that ID on the feed.

get.summary: Liveness probe
get.description: Always responds `200` with no body if the Express process is up. Used by container/orchestrator health checks; performs no internal checks (e.g. database connectivity).

get.summary: Fetch an HLS playlist or segment for an open transcode stream
get.description: Serves a file (`.m3u8` playlist or `.ts` segment) out of an active playback stream's transcode directory, after confirming the stream is open and that the resolved path stays inside the stream's directory (prevents path traversal). If a requested `.ts` segment doesn't exist yet, the server checks whether the stream needs to reset/seek and, if so, emits a `stream_reset` socket event to the client rather than returning the file. Mounted outside `/api` and requires no bearer token; the `stream` ID is a per-session identifier only known to the client that opened the transcode.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: ID of the active HLS transcode stream.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Playlist or segment filename within the stream's directory. Must end in `.m3u8` or `.ts`.

200.description: The requested playlist or segment file.

400.description: `file` resolves outside the stream directory, or does not end in `.m3u8`/`.ts`.

404.description: Stream is not open, or the file does not exist on disk (may also trigger an async stream reset for missing `.ts` segments — see description).

post.summary: Initialize a fresh server by creating the root user
post.description: No bearer token required (there is no user yet). Only usable once: rejected with 500 if a root user already exists (checked via `Database.hasRootUser`). Creates the root user with `newRoot.username` (default `"root"`) and, if `newRoot.password` is provided, a bcrypt hash of it; an empty/omitted password creates a passwordless root user (logged as a warning), which the local auth strategy will subsequently only allow to log in with an empty password.

500.description: Server already has a root user (already initialized)

post.summary: Log in with username and password
post.description: No bearer token required. Rate-limited (`authRateLimiter`; default 40 requests / 10 minutes per client IP, configurable via `RATE_LIMIT_AUTH_*` env vars). Authenticates via the local passport strategy. On success, creates a JWT access token and a refresh-token session; the refresh token is set as an httpOnly cookie unless the `x-return-tokens: true` request header is sent, in which case it is also returned in the JSON body (used by mobile/API clients that cannot rely on cookies). The user's active-only root/passwordless-root rule is enforced by the local strategy (a passwordless root user may only log in with an empty password).

parameters.name: x-return-tokens
parameters.description: Set to "true" to have the refresh token returned in the JSON response body instead of (only) as an httpOnly cookie.

Set-Cookie.description: Sets the httpOnly `refresh_token` cookie when `x-return-tokens` was not `true`.

401.description: Invalid username/password, user inactive, or user not found (passport local strategy failure; generic to avoid user enumeration)

429.description: Too many authentication attempts from this client

post.summary: Log out the current session
post.description: No bearer token required (uses the session's refresh token, from the `refresh_token` cookie or the `x-refresh-token` header, plus passport session state). With `?allDevices=1`, invalidates every refresh-token session for the user instead of just the current one. Always clears the `refresh_token` cookie. If the session was established via OpenID, also clears the `auth_method`/`openid_id_token` cookies and returns the identity provider's end-session (single-logout) URL for the client to redirect to.

parameters.name: allDevices
parameters.description: Set to "1" to invalidate all refresh-token sessions for the user, not just the current one.

parameters.name: x-refresh-token
parameters.description: Alternative to the `refresh_token` cookie for clients that don't use cookies.

redirect_url.description: The identity provider's end-session URL to redirect the browser to, only set when the session used OpenID auth and the provider advertises an end_session_endpoint. Null otherwise.

get.summary: Simple reachability check
get.description: Logs the ping and responds with a static success payload. Unlike `/healthcheck`, this is JSON and logged server-side.

get.summary: Fetch a raw audio track for an open playback session
get.description: Streams the audio file backing track `index` of open playback session `id`. If the session's play method is transcode (HLS) and the track carries a `contentUrl`, redirects there instead of serving directly (workaround for an older Android client bug that hit this endpoint for transcodes). Mounted under `/public`, so no bearer token is required; the session `id` is the effective credential.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Audio track index within the session.

200.description: The audio file. `Content-Type` is corrected from the file extension for formats (e.g. `.m4b`) Express mistypes. When served behind an X-Accel-capable reverse proxy, a `204` with an `X-Accel-Redirect` header is returned instead of the body.

302.description: Redirect to the track's HLS `contentUrl` (transcode play-method sessions only).

400.description: `index` is not a number.

404.description: No session with that ID, or no track at that index.

500.description: Track is missing its backing file path.

get.summary: Get a public media item share and start/resume its playback session
get.description: Looks up the open share by slug (404 if unknown or expired, and removes it if expired). If a valid `share_session_id` cookie already maps to a playback session for this share, returns it (optionally overriding `currentTime` from `?t=`). Otherwise builds a fresh direct-play `PlaybackSession` over the item's audio tracks, registers it with ShareManager, and sets a 30-day `share_session_id` HTTP-only cookie. No bearer token required — the share `slug` (and, for resuming, the `share_session_id` cookie) is the access control.

parameters.name: t
parameters.description: Start time in seconds, applied only when resuming an existing share session and less than its duration.

parameters.name: share_session_id
parameters.description: Set by a prior call to this endpoint; identifies the caller's share playback session.

200.description: The share, with its (possibly newly created) playback session attached. Sets `share_session_id` cookie.

404.description: No such share, the share has expired, or its underlying media item/library item is gone.

get.summary: Get a public share's cover image
get.description: Serves the cover image for the library item behind the share, resolved via the caller's `share_session_id` playback session. No bearer token required, but a valid `share_session_id` cookie (obtained from `GET /public/share/{slug}`) tied to this share is mandatory.

200.description: Cover image, or (behind an X-Accel-capable reverse proxy) a `204` with an `X-Accel-Redirect` header instead of the body.

404.description: Missing `share_session_id` cookie, unknown share, session doesn't belong to this share, or no cover set.

get.summary: Download a public share's media
get.description: Downloads the shared item's underlying file (single-file items) or a zip stream of its directory (multi-file items), if the share was created with `isDownloadable: true`. No bearer token required, but a valid `share_session_id` cookie tied to this share is mandatory.

200.description: The item's audio file, or a `.zip` of its directory for multi-file items.

403.description: The share was not created with `isDownloadable: true`.

404.description: Missing `share_session_id` cookie, unknown share, session doesn't belong to this share, or the library item/file is gone.

patch.summary: Update a public share's playback progress
patch.description: Updates `currentTime` (clamped to the session's `duration`) on the caller's in-memory share playback session. No bearer token required, but a valid `share_session_id` cookie tied to this share is mandatory. Progress lives only in memory for the life of the share session; it is not persisted to a user's normal media-progress record.

400.description: `currentTime` missing, `NaN`, or negative.

404.description: Missing `share_session_id` cookie, unknown share, or session doesn't belong to this share.

get.summary: Get a public share's audio track
get.description: Serves audio track `index` of the caller's share playback session. No bearer token required, but a valid `share_session_id` cookie tied to this share is mandatory.

200.description: The audio track file. `Content-Type` is corrected from the file extension for formats (e.g. `.m4b`) Express mistypes. Behind an X-Accel-capable reverse proxy, a `204` with an `X-Accel-Redirect` header is returned instead of the body.

404.description: Missing `share_session_id` cookie, unknown share, session doesn't belong to this share, or no track at that index.

get.summary: Get server init status
get.description: Reports whether the server has completed first-run initialization (i.e. a root user exists) plus enough public info for the client's login screen (app name, version, language, active auth methods, auth form data). Before initialization, also exposes the configured `ConfigPath`/`MetadataPath` so the setup wizard can display them.
